Akali

the Rogue Assassin
Mid laneTop lane

In top lane, Akali uses her mobility and smoke to out-trade bruisers who can't catch her, then roams or split pushes. She's a counter-pick top laner who punishes immobile champions without strong crowd control. Unlike most top laners, she takes Ignite instead of Teleport.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Akali

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Counter-pick only: many top laners are tanky or have crowd control that beats her. Pick her into immobile bruisers.

Pick into

  • Immobile top laners she can poke, like Rumble or Gwen
  • Melee top laners without hard crowd control
  • Games where you can split push and draw pressure
  • Squishy enemy backlines she can flank later

Avoid into

  • Tanky top laners with crowd control, like Sion
  • Poke top laners like Gangplank
  • Champions like Urgot who punish her all-in
  • Teams with lots of tanks

Great teammates

Jarvan IVEarly ganks into her lane help her snowball.
LeonaLockdown for her dives in teamfights.
OrnnA frontline while she flanks.

Your team needs: A frontline from the jungle or support, since Akali top won't tank.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Mobility and smoke let her out-trade bruisers who rely on getting in melee range
  • Strong at split pushing and escaping when the enemy sends people
  • Ignite plus Electrocute gives big kill pressure in lane
  • Energy means no mana problems in long lanes

Weaknesses

  • Tanky top laners shrug off her burst
  • Champions with strong point-and-click crowd control beat her
  • No Teleport early, so she can't join bot-side fights as easily
  • Falls behind if she loses the early trades

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: Q + Flip trades well with melee bruisers.
  • Level 6: Perfect Execution gives kill pressure.
  • First item (Hextech Gunblade): healing and burst; you can 1v1 most bruisers.
  • Role quest: once you complete it, you get Unleashed Teleport even though you took Ignite.

Top tips

  • Akali top takes Ignite, not Teleport; the role quest gives you Unleashed Teleport later.
  • Poke melee top laners with Q before they can reach you.
  • Freeze the wave near your tower when you're ahead.
  • Use smoke to break tower aggro when you dive.
  • Don't trade with tanky top laners for long: burst and leave.
